summary: Extract the same set of fields from PDFs with different layouts and check the values before saving the JSON.
scope: Illustrative design. At an assumed three seconds per PDF, ten concurrent workers can complete about three PDFs per second. The example queue allows ten concurrent dispatches and a steady dispatch rate of up to five per second.

sources.title: Google Cloud Tasks · Dispatch limits and retries

componentNotes.web: Send the PDF to the API and follow the status for its job.
componentNotes.api: Store the PDF and register the job. Enqueue its job ID and object reference so the worker can fetch the file.
componentNotes.job: Keep the job status and validated fields. The client listens for updates to its job.
componentNotes.processor: Fetch the PDF on Cloud Run. Validate the extracted values and their source excerpts before saving by job ID. Check for a completed job on redelivery.
componentNotes.ocr: Use embedded text where it is readable and OCR for scans. Fill the agreed JSON schema and attach a source excerpt to each extracted value for validation.
componentNotes.files: Keep the source PDF available for processing and retries.
componentNotes.queue: Dispatch one task per PDF. Limit concurrent requests and the dispatch rate to stay within worker capacity and model quotas. Retry transient failures with backoff.
